server_reading.en: Server: reading what review.py admin works against.

server_dev.en: The dev server on this computer.

server_live.en: The live site, through the SSH tunnel that review.py admin keeps open. Every change reaches readers at once.

no_key.en: This page needs the address that review.py admin printed. Run python3 review.py admin and open the address it prints.

bad_key.en: The page's key is wrong. Open the address that review.py admin printed.

api_no_route.en: The page asked for a route the admin server does not have: {route}.

api_offline.en: The admin server does not answer. Check that review.py admin is still running, or start it again and open the address it prints.

api_status.en: The admin server answered with status {status}.

need_spec.en: Write the chapters first, as SC09, SC01-08 or SC.

copy_by_hand.en: Select the link and press Ctrl+C.

link_once_1.en: The new link is shown only this once. Copy it now and send it to the reader.

link_once_n.en: The new links are shown only this once. Copy each one now and send it to its reader.

next_close_members.en: Close {spec} for the members of {group} who hold it as their own

next_close_own_q.en: Take {spec} out of the own chapters of {readers}?

next_close_own_note.en: Only their own chapters change. A group of theirs that opens the chapters still opens them.

next_group_close_note.en: Every member who reads it through the group loses it at once.

next_group_on_note.en: Its members get its chapters and settings again at once.

next_no_readers.en: No reader was found to change, so nothing was sent.

next_relink_note.en: The old link stops working at once. The new link is shown only once, here, with a Copy button, and its first sign-in with LINE or email lets the reader in again.

next_show_requests.en: Show the requests and general links

c_hint.en: Every chapter of every book in books.json: the chapters on the site, published or withdrawn, and the chapters in the repository that were never published. Publish reads the repository at the commit shown above each table. Withdraw hides a chapter from readers and keeps its comments.

c_site_list.en: The chapter list of the site

c_publish_moved.en: {ref} has moved since this page last read it.

c_publish_absent.en: Not in {ref}, so publish will refuse them: {chapters}.

c_publish_note.en: Readers who hold these chapters see the new text at once.

c_publish_read_other.en: Publish read {read}, not {commit}, because {ref} moved after you confirmed.

c_withdraw_note.en: Readers no longer see them. Their comments are kept.

c_packet_out_hint.en: a .json file for the one chapter selected; empty: the default file

r_f_devices.en: Only links on more than two devices or with a device waiting

r_f_link_hint.en: the code never leaves this computer

r_none.en: No readers yet. Invite one below.

r_flag.en: This link was opened on more devices than the {n} it works on without your approval, or a device waits for your approval.

r_selected_none.en: No reader selected. Select readers in the list to act on them.

r_open_note.en: The chapters become each reader's own chapters, and each reader can read them at once.

r_close_note.en: The chapters leave each reader's own chapters at once. When a group of a reader still opens them, the answer says so.

r_revoke_note.en: They are stopped from now on: their links, LINE and email open nothing, and the browsers they signed in on are refused. Their comments are kept, and Restore the links lets them read again.

r_restore_note.en: They can read again at once: the browsers they signed in on work again, and each signs in as before, with LINE or email, or with a link that signs in by itself. A reader whose link was used and who has no LINE account or address left needs a new link.

r_relink_note.en: The old links stop working at once. Each new link is shown only once, here, with a Copy button. The readers keep the LINE accounts and addresses they sign in with, and their browsers stay signed in.

r_english_note.en: This sets each reader's own setting. The English that a group shows stays.

r_feature_note.en: This sets each reader's own setting. A group's setting stays.

v_hint.en: A link that signs in by itself works on the first two devices that open it, and a further device waits for your approval here. That is a reader with Link signs in on, every reader while no sign-in route is on, and a reader who has not yet signed in with LINE or email. Removing a device stops the link on it; if it comes back, it waits for your approval again. A new link starts a new count.

v_all.en: Also the devices of earlier links

v_state_removed.en: removed: the link does not work on it

v_none_waiting.en: No device is waiting for your approval.

v_none_reader.en: No device has opened the link of {name} yet.

v_approve_note.en: The reader's link works on them at once.

v_remove_note.en: The link stops working on them at once. A removed device that comes back waits for your approval again.

dc_title.en: Delete one reader's comments between two dates

dc_hint.en: This clears junk from a misused link. The page first counts the comments the reader wrote from the start of the first day to the end of the last, Thailand time, in every chapter and round, and asks once before it deletes them. A time narrows a day to the minute. The next export names the comments deleted.

dc_time_hint.en: Thailand time; the time may stay empty

dc_need.en: Write the reader's whole name and both dates first.

dc_q.en: Delete the {comments} that {name} wrote from {from} to {to}, Thailand time?

dc_note.en: In {where}. Deleted comments cannot be brought back. The next export names them.

i_chapters_hint.en: several with spaces between; a group may give them instead

m_title.en: Invite many readers from a CSV file

m_hint.en: The first line names the columns: name, groups, grants, english, and any others, such as email. Every reader is created, or none. The links go to a new file of mode 600 beside the admin token, with the other columns; this page shows the file's path, never the links.

m_note.en: Every reader is created, or none. Their links go to a file of mode 600 beside the admin token; this page shows only the file's path.

g_none.en: No groups yet. Create one below.

g_name_hint.en: 1 to 40 letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores

g_create_chapters_hint.en: several with spaces between; may be empty

g_give_each.en: Give each current member their own copy

g_chapters_hint.en: Open for this group: the chapters reach every member while the group is on, members who join later too. Give each current member their own copy: the chapters become each current member's own chapters, which stay when the group is off or the reader leaves it; readers who join later do not get them.

g_is_off_note.en: The group is off, so this reaches its members only after you switch it on.

g_open_q.en: Open {spec} to the group {group} and its {members}?

g_open_note.en: The chapters reach every member while the group is on, members who join later too.

g_close_note.en: Its {members} lose these chapters at once, unless their own chapters or another group open them. The answer names those members, with a button that closes the chapters for them too.

g_give_each_q.en: Give {spec} to each of the {members} of {group} as their own chapters? Readers who join later do not get it.

g_give_each_note.en: Each member keeps these chapters as their own, also when the group is off or they leave it.

g_on_note.en: Its {members} get its chapters and settings again at once.

g_off_note.en: Its {members} lose the chapters and settings it gives them at once, and keep their own chapters.

g_remove_note.en: This cannot be undone. Its {members} keep their own chapters and lose what the group gives them. Its general link stops taking requests, and requests made through it that still wait need chapters or a group when you approve them.

g_english_on_q.en: Turn the English of the group {group} on?

g_english_off_q.en: Turn the English of the group {group} off?

g_setting_note.en: Its {members} see the change at once, while the group is on.

g_csv.en: CSV file with a column name

g_take_out_file.en: Take out the readers in the file

g_in_readers_hint.en: There you can open or close chapters, stop links or make new links for the members you tick.

g_find_hint.en: Type part of a name to find readers to add, or list every reader.

g_found.en: {readers} found among those who are not members.

g_add_file.en: Add the readers in the file

g_add_note.en: They get the group's chapters and settings at once, while it is on.

g_take_out_note.en: They lose what the group gives them at once, and keep their own chapters.

g_need_file.en: Choose a CSV file with a column named name first.

g_add_file_q.en: Add the {readers} of {file} to the group {group}?

g_take_out_file_q.en: Take the {readers} of {file} out of the group {group}?

g_file_note.en: The names come from the column name; the other columns are not read.

g_relink_hint.en: Every member gets a new link, and the old links stop working. The new links go to a file of mode 600 beside the admin token; this page shows the file's path, never the links.

g_relink_none.en: The group {group} has no members, so no link changes.

g_relink_again_q.en: The group {group} now has {members}. Give them new links?

g_relink_note.en: Their old links stop working at once. The new links go to a file of mode 600 beside the admin token; this page shows the file's path, never the links.

g_relink_unbind_q.en: Give the {members} of {group} new links, and remove their LINE accounts and addresses?

g_relink_unbind_again_q.en: The group {group} now has {members}. Give them new links, and remove their LINE accounts and addresses?

g_relink_unbind_note.en: Their old links stop working at once. Every LINE account and address of these members stops signing in, and every browser they are signed in on is signed out, as after a stranger signed in with an old link. The new links go to a file of mode 600 beside the admin token; this page shows the file's path, never the links.

g_relink_title_answer.en: New links for the members of {group}

e_hint.en: Export what changed writes the comments new or changed since the last export made without a filter, as JSON and Markdown, and names the comments deleted since then; when there is no such export, it writes every comment. Export everything writes every comment, and Export the round every comment of one review round. The filters narrow each of them. An export never overwrites another.

e_out_hint.en: a folder, or a new .json file; empty: the export folder

e_need_round.en: No review round has started yet, so there is no round to export.

o_hint.en: Each time a book is opened for review, start a named round. Readers then see only the comments of the current round, and every chapter of the book counts as not yet finished. Earlier rounds stay on the site, and Export the round writes one.

o_none.en: No review round has started for {book}.

o_name_hint.en: 1 to 40 letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores, used once in a book

o_need_name.en: Choose the book and write the round's name first.

o_q.en: Start the review round {name} of {book} now?

o_note.en: Readers then see only the comments they write from now on, and every chapter of {book} counts as not yet finished. The comments of earlier rounds stay on the site.

x_none.en: No export yet. Export writes the first one here.

t_hint.en: Writes one triage packet per chapter, JSON and Markdown, in a folder beside the export, for the Claude session that sorts the comments by assets/read-through.md section 2.

p_hint.en: A CSV file with the columns id and reply, and rev if wanted, or a JSON file of {id, reply, rev}. An empty reply clears one. Each reviewer sees the reply under the comment.

p_need_file.en: Choose a CSV or JSON file of replies first.

p_note.en: Each reviewer sees the reply under the comment at once. An empty reply clears one. A comment its reader changed after the export keeps its old reply when the file gives rev.

d_hint.en: Marks comments as turned into markers, as they stood in the exports. A comment changed by its reader since, or never exported, stays open, and the answer says which.

d_need_ids.en: Write the comment numbers first, as 12 13 20-25.

s_no_repo.en: Not found. Start review.py admin again with --repo PATH to publish.

s_no_dev_data.en: None: backup and a new token work only against the dev server's own data.

s_backup_hint.en: Copies the database into {folder}. Copies older than the days given are deleted, but that many of the newest always stay.

s_need_days.en: Write the days as a whole number, as 14.

s_token_hint.en: Replaces the dev admin token in {file} at once. The old token stops working; this page goes on with the new one.

s_token_q.en: Make a new admin token for the dev server?

s_token_note.en: The old token stops working at once. This page goes on with the new one.

s_live_title.en: Backups and the admin token of the live site

s_live_text.en: Backups of the live site are made on the droplet each day by review-backup.timer; deploy/DEPLOY.md, "Daily backup", gives the command that copies the newest one home. A new admin token for the live site is made on the droplet, as deploy/DEPLOY.md, "What is secret", says.

s_features_hint.en: Each on/off setting can be set for readers and for groups in their sections.

r_devices_full.en: ; tried on too many devices: give a new link

e_before_title.en: Export the comments written before the first round of {book}

once_used.en: This address worked once, when the page first opened, and is used up now. Open the address that review.py admin printed.

r_identity_none.en: no LINE account or address yet

r_signin_used.en: link used; no way to sign in: give a new link

r_signin_none_now.en: none now; the next sign-in is through the link

r_lsi_switch_on_aria.en: Switch Link signs in on for {name}

r_lsi_switch_off_aria.en: Switch Link signs in off for {name}

r_lsi_hint.en: For a reader with neither LINE nor email: the personal link then signs in by itself, with the two-device lock.

r_lsi_on_q.en: Switch Link signs in on for {readers}?

r_lsi_on_note.en: Their links then sign in by themselves on the first two devices that open them, as before accounts. A further device waits for your approval.

r_lsi_off_q.en: Switch Link signs in off for {readers}?

r_lsi_off_note.en: They then sign in with LINE or email. A reader who has not signed in that way yet keeps the link until the first sign-in, unless config.json sets auth.require_identity.

r_unbind.en: and remove their LINE accounts and addresses

r_relink_unbind_q.en: Give {readers} new links, and remove their LINE accounts and addresses?

r_relink_unbind_one_q.en: Give {name} a new link, and remove the LINE accounts and addresses of {name}?

r_relink_unbind_note.en: The old links stop working at once. Every LINE account and address of these readers stops signing in, and every browser they are signed in on is signed out, as after a stranger signed in with an old link. Each new link is shown only once, here, with a Copy button.

i_lsi_hint.en: For a reader with neither LINE nor email: the link signs in by itself, with the two-device lock.

a_hint.en: Each reader signs in with a LINE account or with a six-digit code sent to an email address, and stays signed in on each browser for {days} after the last visit. Removing a LINE account or address stops it signing in and signs out the browsers it signed in. A reader whose link is used and who has no way left to sign in needs a new link.

a_all.en: Also browsers signed out in the last 90 days

a_remove_note.en: It no longer signs in to {name}, and {browsers} it signed in are signed out now.

a_address_hint.en: the reader can then sign in with a code sent to it, without the link

a_add.en: Let this reader sign in with this address

a_add_need.en: Show one reader's sign-in first, then write the email address.

a_via_dev.en: Enter as, on the dev server

a_state_active.en: signed in until {time} unless visited again

a_state_ended_unbind.en: signed out when its LINE account or address was removed, {time}

a_state_ended_relink.en: signed out by a new link that removed the reader's LINE accounts and addresses, {time}

a_state_ended_signin.en: signed out when the browser signed in as another reader, {time}

a_state_ran_out.en: ran out {time}, {days} after its last visit

a_end_note.en: Each browser is signed out at its next request. The reader signs in again with LINE or email.

a_signout.en: Sign this reader out on every browser

a_signout_q.en: Sign {name} out on every browser ({browsers} signed in now)?

a_signout_note.en: Each browser is signed out at its next request. The reader signs in again with LINE or email.

q_hint.en: A person who opens a group's general link signs in with LINE or email, and the request comes here. Nothing opens to that person before you approve the request. Approve it as a new reader, with a name, chapters and groups, or for a reader who exists; or decline it. A declined LINE account or address cannot ask again until you forget the request.

q_none_open.en: No request is waiting for you.

q_name_hint_email.en: The address would become the reader's name; write the person's name instead.

q_name_hint_line.en: The name the person uses on LINE; change it as you wish.

q_chapters_hint.en: several with spaces between; leave empty to give only the groups ticked

q_reader_title.en: Or for a reader who exists

q_reader_hint.en: the request's LINE account or address then signs in to this reader

q_approve_reader_note.en: The request's LINE account or address then signs in to that reader, and opens what that reader reads.

q_need_reader.en: Write the whole name of the reader this request belongs to.

q_decline_note.en: Nothing opens to that person, and the same LINE account or address cannot ask again until you forget the request.

q_forget_note.en: The request is removed from the list, and that LINE account or address may ask again.

gl_hint.en: A group's general link lets people ask to read: each signs in with LINE or email, and the request waits here for you. A link takes requests until it expires or takes its number of requests. Making a new one stops the group's link before it, and a link switched off never works again. The new link is shown only once, with a Copy button.

gl_state_open.en: open until {time}, for up to {uses} requests in all

gl_off_q.en: Switch off the general link of {group}?

gl_off_note.en: It stops taking requests now, for good. The requests made through it stay here. A new general link takes requests again.

gl_off_title.en: Switch off the general link of {group}

gl_new_q.en: Make a new general link of {group}, for {days} days or {uses} requests?

gl_new_note.en: Anyone with the link can ask to read; nothing opens before you approve a request. The link is shown only once, here, with a Copy button.

gl_new_note_replaces.en: The link of {group} before it stops taking requests now. Anyone with the new link can ask to read; nothing opens before you approve a request. The link is shown only once, here, with a Copy button.

gl_need_group.en: Choose the group of the new general link.

gl_need_numbers.en: Days and requests are whole numbers from 1 up, or empty for the settings of config.json.

s_signin_hint.en: The sign-in settings of config.json in the site's data directory, as review.py signin shows them. They change only in config.json, and the site reads them when it starts (README.md, "Sign-in settings").

s_last_mail_none.en: No mail has been sent since the log began.

s_mail_approved.en: a note to an approved requester

s_check_hint.en: whether the site reaches LINE and the mail provider; it signs no one in and sends no mail

s_test_need.en: Write the address the test mail goes to.
